reviewer: Claude（Claude Code 会话）：faster-whisper small.en 与 medium.en 两档逐词转写交叉核对，并对照本地抽帧；未人工听音

foreground_english.en: Does the foot touch the line?
That's a tough judgment call, isn't it?
Has he put enough pressure onto the front part of the foot to touch the line?
foreground_english.zh: 他前脚掌压下去，碰到线了吗？

review_note: Tennis TV 官方。两档逐词一致（medium 47.02–61.62；small 47.06–61.60），medium 把 onto 记成 on to，按 small 写。段首 46.85 在上一句 as we'll see（46.78）之后。
